feedback_summary: The script demonstrates good comprehension of the chart by accurately incorporating every data point and identifying both maximum and minimum values. However, the organization is unstructured and repeats sectors unnecessarily. Language mechanics need improvement, specifically regarding spelling precision and grammatical accuracy.
